top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §747.3101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Lunch was observed at the beginning of the inspection. Children were being served Ramen noodles and water.     This was corrected at the end of the inspection after being prompted by the CCR inspector that Ramen noodles do not comply with CACFP guidelines. The provider began  cooking a second meal of cabbage and sausage to serve the children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection report was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §747.4815(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection a water hose in the yard was not stored out of reach.  This was corrected at inspection by the provider storing the water hose as required so that it is inaccessible.

top_violation_types.title: Maintain Menus (26 TAC §747.3113(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A menu was not available for review.
